general news.headline: Live: 'Kar lo jo karna hai', dares Rahul Gandhi ahead of INDIA bloc march to SCDelhi Protest News Live Updates: The Congress-led INDIA bloc is set to march to the Supreme Court on Monday under the call of "Chalo Delhi - March for Democracy", demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over allegations of "vote chori". Ahead of the march, Rahul Gandhi accused the Modi government of protecting Gyanesh Kumar and questioned the heavy security deployment across Delhi, asking why the city had been turned into a "fortress". He also claimed that 200 government officers were in touch with the Opposition and sharing information with them. The march is scheduled to begin at 1.30 pm from the Connaught Place-Barakhamba Road junction, with Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav also expected to join the protest. Meanwhile, the Delhi High Court has agreed to hear on October 13 a plea challenging the closure of Jantar Mantar for peaceful protests, while listing a separate petition concerning the October 10 and 11 protests for the same day. Ahead of the march, entry and exit at six Metro stations, Patel Chowk, Janpath, Rajiv Chowk, Mandi House, Central Secretariat and Barakhamba Road, have been shut until 4 pm for security reasons, though interchange facilities remain available. Stay tuned to this live blog for the latest developments, political reactions and security updates from Delhi.

We know you're losing sleep, will make sure you quit: Rahul Gandhi to Gyanesh KumarThe Leader of the Opposition also accused the Narendra Modi government of protecting the Chief Election Commissioner, claiming that the heavy police deployment in central Delhi was intended to send a message that the government was shielding him.
